generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: polished ultra-wide website hero illustration.
Input image 1: the approved existing penthouse city illustration, edit target. Preserve its room design, furnishings, palette, perspective, and integrated seated developer.
Primary request: Widen the illustration into a genuine 2:1 landscape composition, ideally 2048 by 1024 pixels. Pull the camera back a little and expand the city extensively to the left and right. The warm penthouse stays centered and remains the main focal point, taking approximately half the width of the wide canvas. Show more surrounding city blocks and distinct buildings, some additional street intersections, rooftop gardens, restrained cyan and violet neon, and warm lit windows. Match the existing diagonal aerial/isometric tilt and polished crisp illustrated pixel-inspired rendering; keep fine details and avoid coarse pixel blocks.
Room invariants: retain tall rear and side walls, glass railing, warm recessed lighting, bed and bookcase, restrained plants, lounge chair and rug, the seated developer naturally embedded at the left desk working on a large visible black laptop with green illuminated keys, and the small orange kitten curled asleep in its charcoal cushion. Retain the open cutaway architectural presentation. Do not add extra people in the room.
City additions: integrate just 3 or 4 tiny people naturally into street-level sidewalks, very small relative to the buildings, with coherent perspective. Keep the city sophisticated and spacious, with several clear continuous street lane segments visible at the bottom left and bottom right for later animation.
All streets MUST be completely car-free: no parked vehicles, no moving vehicles, no taxi or bus. Traffic will be animated separately. Pedestrians stay on sidewalks. Keep unobstructed asphalt lanes with crisp coherent road markings. No text, no logos, no new billboard graphics, no arrows or diagram labels, no watermark, no border. Avoid duplicated central rooms or buildings floating out of scale. The center room should read clearly and remain inviting while the broader city feels inhabited.

preserved: Tall walls and diagonal aerial cutaway penthouse
Warm furnished room with bed, bookcase, lounge and modest plants
Seated developer embedded at the desk with a visible large laptop
Orange kitten curled asleep in charcoal cushion
added: Expanded city blocks and multiple distinct surrounding buildings
Broader car-free street segments and intersections
inspection.notes: The penthouse remains the central focal point. Tiny pedestrians are static details baked into the illustration. Streets are car-free. The earlier animated traffic overlay was removed because its estimated masks did not match foreground buildings reliably.
